failed_checks.title: No very long sentences
failed_checks.evidence: Reading too much text at once is hard because models have a limited context window, which is the maximum amount of text a model can read at one time.
failed_checks.fix: Split each long sentence into two or three short ones.

failed_checks.title: Listed jargon terms are defined where first used
failed_checks.reason: Term 'vector database' is used but not explained within 3 sentences of first use.
failed_checks.evidence: You store all these embeddings inside a special vector database or index for fast searching.
failed_checks.fix: Define 'vector database' in plain words where it first appears.

failed_checks.title: Every technical term explained in plain words at first use
failed_checks.reason: The technical term 'prompt' is introduced and used without explaining what it means in plain words.
failed_checks.evidence: You add those retrieved text chunks into the prompt along with the original question.
failed_checks.fix: Explain what a 'prompt' is (e.g., the input message or instructions given to an AI model) when the term first appears.

failed_checks.title: Language suits a non-native English reader

failed_checks.fix: Replace 'prone to hallucinations' with simpler wording like 'likely to make up answers'.
